Staff Vacancy
Friday, 21 February 2025
5267 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the below mentioned posts which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
03/05/2025
.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory, copy of the same to be submitted along with application
.
Senior
Clerk : 1 Posts (1 Open)
Qualification & Experience:
Must be a graduate from any recognized University in India with 5 years’ experience in Medical / Engineering / Educational Institutions as Junior Clerk and should have proficiency in computer application with MSCIT / equivalent qualification, typing, drafting in English & Marathi language. Candidate having knowledge of Personnel / Academic Section will be preferred.
Driver cum Attendant
: 2 Posts (1 SBC, 1 Open )
Qualification & Experience:
Must be SSC/ HSC from recognized board, must have valid Driving Transport License of Light & Heavy Vehicle (with bus badge) with 2 years’ experience as Driver.
Conductor cum Attendant : 1 Post (1 Open)
Qualification & Experience:
Must be SSC from recognized board, must have valid Conductor License / badge with experience as College/School Bus Conductor for 2 years. Candidate having Heavy Vehicle License & badge will be preferred.
Mechanic : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification:
SSC and Regular ITI in Electrical, DTE (Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra Board) from Govt. approved Institute.
Experience:
At least 05 years in the Institute / Industry Gadgets like fans, exhaust fans, cooler motors and AC motors, sterilizers, geysers, invertors, UPS, Generators (upto 50 KVA) & knowledge of Automation with repairs of all types of starters. The candidate having additional Skill / Diploma / Certificate course of rewinding work will be preferred.
Carpenter : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification:
SSC (Compulsory) with Diploma / ITI in Carpentry.
Experience:
At least 03 years with an organization having annual turnover of Rs.50.00 lacs. Candidate having additional skill related to Engineering trades will be preferred.
Mason : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification:
SSC (Compulsory)
Experience:
At least 05 years of experience in Govt. registered PWD Contractor. Candidate having additional skill related to Engineering trades will be preferred
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General category / between 18-43 for reserved category
Note:
1.
Application to be submitted to the Dean, MGIMS for the above mentioned post.
Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Dean reserves right to reject any or all application.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final and binding.
Institute reserves the right to adopt varying selection process for different posts.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview.
DEAN
